name: Crime Time
source:
After a long day working as an accountant you find yourself... a criminal?! As a contestant on the country's hit criminal game show Crime Time, you'll have to balance competing,  getting to know your fellow contestants, and maybe even building relationships! Win or lose, you'll find out soon on Crime Time!

[From [url=https://skylilywolf.itch.io/crime-time-part-1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
忙碌一整天当会计后，你竟发现自己成了……罪犯？！作为全国热门犯罪真人秀《Crime Time》的参赛者，你得兼顾比赛、结识其他选手，甚至可能发展关系！胜负如何，很快就会在《Crime Time》揭晓！

[来源：[url=https://skylilywolf.itch.io/crime-time-part-1]Itch.io[/url]]
